Women in politics are the most targeted for violence, stalking, and harassment. I am horrified that Hakeem Jeffries is calling for “violence,” especially against members like myself. I have a young child. I already require security at public events, and I already have a nut job in prison for threatening to murder me.

The fact that he thinks this is normal is something that should be called out for what it is. Hakeem himself said it’s time to “unify,” and then did this. Apparently, he wants to s
Thune is BLOCKING VOTER ID. It’s Thune. He controls the Senate.

We will slaughter the Farm Bill if Sections 10205, 10206 and 10207 are NOT REMOVED @HouseGOP

Section 10205 would shield pesticide makers from liability, weaken warning labels, and put foreign chemical corporations above the health of American families.

Sections 10206 and 10207 would strip protections that help keep dangerous pesticides out of our children’s playgrounds, communities, and drinking water.

Today was an absolute honor to present the City of Clearwater with a check for $1.7 million for their local stormwater improvement project, making sure your Florida 13 tax dollars are going back into our Florida 13 communities.
Letters like this remind me why I wake up everyday and choose to fight the good fight 💪🏼
Spotted in DC today 👀 Family farmers support the Luna amendment!

Jimmy Kimmel isn’t doing comedy, he’s pushing hateful, hostile rhetoric that poisons the country and puts real targets on real people. Right after an assassination attempt too. 

Why does ABC keep handing him the mic? Until the media is held accountable for promoting violence, they’re complicit.


First Lady Melania Trump (@FLOTUS)

Kimmel’s hateful and violent rhetoric is intended to divide our country.  His monologue about my family isn’t comedy- his words are corrosive and deepens the politic

You literally just reposted Hakeem Jeffries quote calling for “total warfare everywhere” only a days ago. Start being responsible with your platform instead of calling for violence.


Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (@RepAOC)

There is no place for political violence in our country.

I am relieved that the President and the attendees at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner last night are safe.

You can tell a lot about a man about how they instinctively respond when it hits the fan. 

In this photo, Stephen Miller moves on top of his pregnant wife to protect her. 

Pete Hegseth stands over his wife, surveying the scene while leaning over,  protecting her.
